title: Food and drink branding in Ontario
answer: KNGHT builds brand worlds for food and drink brands, from cafes and coffee importers to dessert makers: the name, packaging, labels, menus and a site that sells, with every allergen, health and sourcing claim checked against CFIA, Health Canada and the Competition Act. Every engagement starts with a Verdict, a scored audit, from $3,500 CAD in 5 business days.
